description: This file is a documentation source for the Playwright API, describing classes, properties, methods, and usage examples related to the Playwright automation library.

classes.name: Playwright
classes.description: Represents the Playwright automation framework, providing properties and methods to launch browsers, access devices, handle errors, and create Playwright instances.

methods.name: Playwright.close
methods.description: Terminates the Playwright instance, closing all associated browsers if still open.

methods.name: Playwright.create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Playwright driver instance, returning a Playwright object.

methods.name: Playwright.stop
methods.description: Terminates the Playwright instance, intended for use outside context managers in REPL or script environments.
